43.sql:
WITH c_rows AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrMath`, ss.`AvgScrRead`, ss.`AvgScrWrite`, s.`County`
    FROM satscores AS ss
    INNER JOIN schools AS s ON ss.cds = s.`CDSCode`
    WHERE ss.`AvgScrMath` IS NOT NULL AND ss.`AvgScrRead` IS NOT NULL AND ss.`AvgScrWrite` IS NOT NULL
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_total_score, County
    FROM c_rows
    GROUP BY cds, County
),
c_min AS (
    SELECT cds, County
    FROM c_agg
    ORDER BY avg_total_score ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT AvgScrMath, County
FROM c_rows
WHERE cds = (SELECT cds FROM c_min);

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT `isStorySpotlight`, `isTextless`, `id`
    FROM cards
),

    SELECT `isStorySpotlight`, `isTextless`, `id`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `isStorySpotlight` = 1 AND `isTextless` = 0
),
c_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS story_spotlight_count
    FROM c_rows
),
c_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM cards
),

    FROM c_count, c_total
),
t_ids AS (
    SELECT `id`
    FROM c_rows
)
SELECT percentage FROM final_percentage
UNION ALL
SELECT id FROM t_ids;

    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON h.id = ha.hero_id
    JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id

)

)

    FROM qualifying AS q

    WHERE t.best_q2 IS NOT NULL AND t.best_q2 != ''

INNER JOIN drivers d ON t.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY t.best_q2 ASC

    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
),
c_final AS (
    SELECT rs.driverId, COUNT(*) AS accident_count
    FROM c_race r
    INNER JOIN results rs ON r.raceId = rs.raceId
    WHERE rs.statusId = 3
    GROUP BY rs.driverId
)

FROM c_final
ORDER BY accident_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

1040.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT p.`player_name`, pa.`heading_accuracy`, p.`height`
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.`player_api_id` = pa.`player_api_id`
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `player_name`, `heading_accuracy`, `height`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `height` > 180
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT `player_name`, AVG(`heading_accuracy`) AS avg_heading_accuracy
    FROM c_rows
    GROUP BY `player_name`
)
SELECT `player_name`
FROM c_agg
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;
